node: Transmission hardware, line fittings, conductor support, and installation-specific components
summary: Layer 1B expanded the investable universe around qualified transmission hardware and adjacent installation-specific components. The cleanest underfollowed candidate found is PLPC, which appears unusually close to the node through line fittings, conductor support, string hardware, insulators, and splice/termination products. ACA and VMI are adjacent structural-hardware candidates tied to utility structures and grid hardening, but less pure than PLPC. HUBB is included only as a reference anchor because it has relevant utility connectors/substation/transmission exposure, including DMC Power, but is much larger and more diversified.
